title: WeddingShotPlan
description: Compiled multi-angle shot plan produced in Phase 3 after guardrail injection, directing-table diversity verification, and continuity locking, ready for adapter formatting in Phase 4.

session_id.description: Links back to the SessionState that generated this plan.

matrix_id.description: Shot matrix identifier used to compile frames, e.g. 8-angle-cinematic, 4-angle-editorial, story-timeline-8.

aesthetic_tagline_zh.description: Scene-matched Chinese photographic aesthetic direction tagline injected across the set.

aesthetic_tagline_en.description: Scene-matched English photographic aesthetic direction tagline injected across the set.

guardrails_applied.description: List of guardrail modules injected into every shot in this plan.

continuity_anchors.description: Shared visual locks that must remain invariant across every frame and batch.

batch_index.description: Optional batch number when delivering individual images in batches (e.g. 1 for shots 1-4, 2 for shots 5-8).

role.description: Narrative role of the shot in the set, e.g. Epic Establishing Wide Shot.

micro_zone.description: Concrete shootable sub-location inside the venue (e.g. sunlit window threshold, carved stone steps).

framing.description: Shot scale and composition rule, e.g. Full-body wide shot, rule-of-thirds right placement.

angle.description: Camera angle and focal perspective, e.g. Eye-level 3/4 side profile, 85mm f/1.8.

pose.description: Specific micro-action, gaze direction, and couple interaction unique to this shot.

bride_hand_action.description: Explicit placement and action of the bride's hands (e.g. lifting floating veil edge with one hand, holding bouquet or resting on groom's arm).

groom_hand_action.description: Explicit placement and action of the groom's hands (e.g. holding the blush rose bouquet, gently supporting bride's waist or holding her hand).

handheld_prop_state.description: Explicit handheld item state and reference-object cleanup directive (e.g. remove all reference pamphlets/everyday objects; hold 15-rose bouquet only; veil flowing dynamically in breeze).

body_mechanics.description: 2-4 framing-visible key body mechanics points (never describe unseen limbs).

contact_topology.description: Couple relationship topology: initiator/respondent, spacing, contact point, orientation, weight counterbalance.

expression_gaze.description: Reactive expression beat and gaze pattern (de-locked from reference photo static expression).

panel_identity_reset.description: When true (multi-panel preview mode), injects explicit per-panel identity reconstruction from canonical original reference.

participants_present.description: Optional list of participant IDs visible in this shot (e.g. ['P01', 'P02', 'P03']) for multi-person group shoots.

participant_directions.description: Optional per-person choreography directions matching participants_present (enforcing Detail Floor for 3+ people).

prompt_zh.description: Complete Chinese generation prompt with all active guardrails injected.

prompt_en.description: Complete English generation prompt with all active guardrails injected.

negative_prompt.description: Anti-artifact constraints preventing proportion distortion, flat hair, and continuity drift.

share_card.description: Optional social media share card compiled for sharing or remixing the set.
